<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\View;

class ProfileController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display user profile with custom theme script loading
     */
    public function show(Request $request, $username)
    {
        // Normalize username for lookup - handles international characters
        $normalized = $this->normalizeUsername($username);
        
        $user = DB::table('users')
            ->where('username', $normalized)
            ->first();

        if (!$user) {
            abort(404);
        }

        // User can specify a custom theme JS file from approved CDN
        $themeScript = $user->theme_script_url ?? 'https://cdn.example.com/themes/default.js';
        
        // Validate the script URL domain
        $parsed = parse_url($themeScript);
        if (!$this->isApprovedCDN($parsed['host'] ?? '')) {
            $themeScript = 'https://cdn.example.com/themes/default.js';
        }

        return view('profile.show', [
            'user' => $user,
            'themeScript' => $themeScript,
            'themeIntegrity' => $user->theme_integrity ?? null,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Unicode normalization for username lookup
     * Converts to NFC form for consistent database matching
     */
    private function normalizeUsername(string $input): string
    {
        // Strip null bytes
        $input = str_replace("\0", '', $input);
        
        // Apply NFKC normalization - this collapses certain Unicode sequences
        if (function_exists('normalizer_normalize')) {
            $input = \Normalizer::normalize($input, \Normalizer::FORM_KC);
        }
        
        return $input;
    }

    /**
     * Check if host is in approved CDN list
     * Uses normalized comparison to prevent bypass
     */
    private function isApprovedCDN(string $host): bool
    {
        $approved = [
            'cdn.example.com',
            'assets.example.com',
            'static.example.com',
        ];

        // Normalize the host for comparison
        $normalizedHost = $this->normalizeUsername(strtolower($host));
        
        return in_array($normalizedHost, $approved);
    }

    /**
     * Update user theme preferences
     */
    public function updateTheme(Request $request)
    {
        $user = auth()->user();
        
        $scriptUrl = $request->input('theme_script_url');
        $integrity = $request->input('theme_integrity');

        // Validate URL format
        if (!filter_var($scriptUrl, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL)) {
            return back()->withErrors(['Invalid URL format']);
        }

        // Check domain after Unicode normalization
        $parsed = parse_url($scriptUrl);
        $host = $parsed['host'] ?? '';
        
        if (!$this->isApprovedCDN($host)) {
            return back()->withErrors(['Script must be hosted on approved CDN']);
        }

        // Store the theme preference - integrity hash is user-supplied
        DB::table('users')
            ->where('id', $user->id)
            ->update([
                'theme_script_url' => $scriptUrl,
                'theme_integrity' => $integrity,
            ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Theme updated');
    }
}

environment.description: Laravel 10.x application on PHP 8.2 with intl extension. Deployed on AWS EC2 behind a basic NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). The Blade template renders the integrity attribute directly from user-supplied data. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured. The CDN (cdn.example.com) serves user-uploaded theme files without content verification. Unicode NFKC normalization of hostnames allows homograph attacks where characters like U+FF43 (fullwidth 'c') normalize to 'c', enabling domain validation bypass when the URL is stored pre-normalization but validated post-normalization.
